pages.description: The MOCA Package Specification: manifest, OKF content, evidence, locales, trust fields, structure, members, relations, digest, profiles and capabilities.
The MOCA Reader Contract: what every conforming Reader must do, from reading and verifying to citation records, retrieval policy, search and structure.
The MOCA Reader Interface: the operations every Reader offers, named for each language, including search, structure, embedders and retrieval hooks.
MOCA Attestations: package and review attestations, DSSE with Ed25519 keys and Sigstore, trust roots, and verification outcomes.
The MOCA Sidecar Index Specification: portable lexical and vector indexes for a package, bound to its digest, with exact offsets for citation.

pages.description: MOCA profiles: named, versioned extensions to the package format, how they work, and the registry of known profiles.

The MOCA conformance corpus: test cases with pinned results that every Reader, in any language, must pass to read packages the same way.
